standard_prerequisites.name: Descent data relative to a morphism and to a family

core_obligations: Decomposition: Y x_X Y = coprod_{ij} X_i x_X X_j and similarly for higher fibre products (proof lines 3594-3600).

Equivalence: giving a morphism V -> Y is exactly giving a family V_i -> X_i, and giving a descent datum phi is exactly giving a family phi_ij compatible with the decomposition; hence the category of descent data relative to the family is canonically equivalent to that relative to Y/X, mapping (V_i, phi_ij) to (coprod V_i, coprod phi_ij) (proof lines 3594-3600).
proof_roadmap: Coproduct decomposition of the fibre products; termwise identification of objects and data.
difficulty_reason: Equivalence of categories via the coproduct decomposition of Y x_X Y and its iterates; the load-bearing observation is stated and used in-span. H2: single mechanism, categorical assembly.
